meta.name: customer-onboarding-and-implementation
meta.description: Takes a new customer from signature to working — setting a definition of live that both sides agreed before the contract was signed, planning and staffing the implementation, running data migration and integration realistically, training the people who will actually use it, and handing over to the ongoing relationship. Use this to design an onboarding motion, rescue a stalled implementation, work out why customers who bought never went live, or scope the services a deal actually needs.

copy.tagline: 帮新客户从签约走到正式启用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责让签约客户真正用起来
copy.tagline_en: Help new customers go from signed contract to actual go-live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're in charge of getting signed customers to genuinely use the product

howto.what: 按技能内容指导客户上线与实施:先约定上线标准、安排客户方负责人,分阶段推进尽早见效,管理数据迁移与对接,培训实际使用者,最后做交接。
howto.when: 当你要求设计客户上线流程、挽救停摆的实施,或分析买了却没上线的客户时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一套客户上线流程
say.note: 会先询问上线标准和负责人

say.text: 有个客户实施好久没进展,怎么推进?
say.note: 会从卡点入手给出推进步骤

say.text: 客户签了约却一直没上线,帮我查原因
say.note: 会按常见失败点逐项排查

howto.what_en: Gives a process to take a customer from signed contract to real use: define go-live criteria before signing, secure a customer-side owner, phase rollout for early wins, plan data migration and integrations, train for the job, and hand over with context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe designing an onboarding motion, rescuing a stalled implementation, analyzing why customers never went live, or scoping the services a deal needs.

say_en.text: Help me design a customer onboarding flow.
say_en.note: You'll get a phased onboarding plan.

say_en.text: A customer's implementation is stuck. How do we move it forward?
A customer signed but never went live. Find out why.
